## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future. He aspires to enter the political sphere and eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane once dared Arty Gillis to jump over an old well and previously fought and beat [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) for claiming that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs about her recitations. He also told his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school. Additionally, Charlie shared a story that his grandmother had seen his deceased grandfather driving home cows a year after he was buried.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P29](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_
